propositions: On-demand workflow_dispatch-only CI job boots amd64 Jira DC image and maps environment contract (fields, types, statuses, workflows, priorities, link types, field limits) via structured REST interrogation without runtime discovery or LLM-summarised prose.

Committed data (raw request/response evidence per question, digest provenance, vocabulary mismatches) consumed by harness setup assertion without re-derivation at test time, traceable to evidence rather than model interpretation.

Map detects vocabulary mismatches for four vocabularies: issue types per template, status names/transitions/destinations, priorities, and link types (including inward/outward direction flags), with verdicts per entry (present/absent/present-but-different).

Field character limits measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back verification to detect accept-and-truncate, and jira.text.field.character.limit read from instance rather than assumed; coverage gap for description/comment limits filed separately.
Digest pin derived from Dockerfile FROM line not hardcoded second literal; committed in doc and asserted against source to prevent staleness across re-pins.
Control flow prevents mutation (REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1), fork execution (dispatch-only asserted by test), and unattended ticket mutation (findings recorded in artifact, human review before posting).
